discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
rationale: Topological insulators have been a leading condensed-matter candidate for years, with many major prizes already awarded (Breakthrough, Dirac, Wolf-level recognition). Kane and Mele's Z2 theory plus Molenkamp's HgTe quantum-well experiment form a clean theory-plus-experiment trio. The 2016 topology prize covered earlier theory, so a prize for the material class itself would be a natural follow-on. The 2025 prize went to quantum circuits, but condensed matter remains under-rewarded compared with its impact.
